messages.subject: Saudi Arabia Executive Leadership | Energy, Infrastructure, ESG and Government Relations
messages.body:
Dear Nizmara Team,

Your Saudi executive-search work across C-suite, country leadership, Director-level mandates, energy and infrastructure makes this a relevant introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans senior government and regulatory engagement, ESG and sustainability, corporate and external affairs, strategic partnerships, stakeholder strategy, executive advisory and cross-functional country-facing delivery within a major multinational mining operation.

Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority. I would welcome confidential consideration for Director, Senior Director, Country Leadership, Government Relations, External or Corporate Affairs, ESG and Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Chief of Staff and Executive Operations mandates across energy, infrastructure, mining and industrial organisations.

My Gulf-focused executive CV is attached. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

Preferred reply/contact: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
